race.title: Mr Binman Christmas Racing Festival 26th - 29th December Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
race.verdict: From his lower mark over hurdles, CAHIRDOWN BOY ran well when making the frame at Fairyhouse a week ago and he could be ready to get back to winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Kayla's Friend who left her stable debut effort behind when going close at the same course, with No Big Deal also considered. CAHIRDOWN BOY (IRE) KAYLA'S FRIEND (IRE) NO BIG DEAL (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Kayla's Friend (3/1), Cahirdown Boy (4/1), Jonzac (9/2), Depalma (5/1), No Big Deal (8/1), Mydreamtell (10/1), Lord De Choisel (10/1), Whiskey Serenade (12/1), Finnicky Filly (12/1), Wildhorserider (14/1), Sum Story (16/1), Kalsman (16/1), Portetta (16/1), Bridge View Star (20/1), Glory Sky (25/1), Imbolc (33/1), Quirt Evans (33/1)
